diagnosis: While get_queryset() restricts active leads to the user's assigned territories, the custom action restore_deleted uses Version.objects.get_deleted(SalesLead) globally by object_id. It performs reversion without verifying that the deleted lead's historical assigned_territory belongs to request.user.territories. A sales agent can resurrect, inspect, and claim high-value client leads deleted by rival sales teams in other territories.
